certification_disabled_reason: Historical calibration-box and software-environment identity is insufficient to establish a certifying profile. Preserve these numbers as provenance only; freshly calibrate a deliberately established local profile before enabling certification.
machine_profile_policy: Historical operator label only. This ID is not a hardware fingerprint, and typing it cannot authenticate the calibration environment.
commit: 91eef58 (v0.16.0 + RFC-8 bug-half fix), recalibrated with warmup exclusion after round-1 review
profile_description: Non-certifying historical record: 16-core reference box from the 2026-07-28 audit; benchmark commands set OMP_NUM_THREADS, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS, and MKL_NUM_THREADS to 1. Tensor references are medians of 5 steady reps with 1 warmup excluded. The record does not identify a reproducible current machine/software profile.
notes: All wall-time thresholds and within-run ratios below are historical provenance and are disabled. Hosted CI and unknown workstations cannot certify them. Certification becomes available only after fresh same-profile calibration on a deliberately established stable local machine, software, data, and thread environment.
artifact_provenance: The benchmark JSON files retain complete-fit repetition timings, numerical outputs, direct backend dispatch, row/design dimensions, and whole-process peak RSS when available. RSS remains recorded provenance and is not a threshold.
historical_hosted_ci_observation: Non-certifying history only: ubuntu-latest runs on 2026-07-29 reported tensor medians 0.328/0.216/1.192/0.590 seconds, tensor ratios 3.63/2.73, and flagship medians 1.02-1.04 seconds. Hosted-runner observations do not calibrate or certify this local profile.
